question_annotated:
A cikin darajar {teacher,Mr. Roper} mai dalibai {total,30}, kashi {p1,20}% na darajar su ne {group1,'yan wasan kwallon kafa}. Daga sauran dalibai, kashi {p2,25}% na dalibai ne {group2,'yan kungiyar taimako} ko na {group3,ƙungiyar kiɗa}. Waɗannan rukunoni uku na dalibai za su buƙaci fita da wuri a yau don tafiya zuwa {event,wasa} a waje. Yaushe dalibai ne za su fita da wuri?

#init:
- teacher = sample(['Ms. Johnson', 'Mr. Smith', 'Dr. Lee', 'Mrs. Garcia'])
- group1 = sample(['yan wasan kwallon kafa', 'yan wasan kwallon kwando', 'yan wasan kwallon ƙwallon ƙafa', 'yan wanki'])
- group2, group3 = sample(['yan rawa', 'mambobin kungiyar murya', 'mambobin ƙungiyar muhawara', 'mambobin ƙungiyar robot'],  2)
- event = sample(['gasar', 'gasar cin kofin', 'wasan kwaikwayo', 'taron'])
- $total = range(20, 150)
- $p1 = range(10, 50)
- $p2 = range(15, 45)

#conditions:
- p1 < 100
- p2 < 100
- is_int(total * p1 / 100)
- is_int((total - total * p1 / 100) * p2 / 100)

#answer: int(total * p1 / 100 + (total - total * p1 / 100) * p2 / 100)

Akwai kwallaye masu launin {c1,ja} {n1,3}, kwallaye masu launin {c2,shuɗi} {n2,11} da kwallaye masu launin {c3,kore} {n3,25} a cikin {place,dakin sayarwa}. Kwallaye masu launin {c1,ja} suna da farashin {cur,$}{p1,9}, kwallaye masu launin {c2,shuɗi} suna da farashin {cur,$}{p2,5} kuma kwallaye masu launin {c3,kore} suna da farashin {cur,$}{p3,3}. Nawa ne {place,dakin sayarwa} zai samu bayan an sayar da dukkan kwallayen?

#init:
- place = sample(["dakin sayarwa", "kasuwa", "kasuwar", "gidan adana kayayyaki"])
- c1, c2, c3 = sample(["ja", "shuɗi", "kore", "rawaya", "shuɗi mai duhu", "lemon", "ruwan hoda"], 3)
- cur = sample(currencies_sym)
- $n1 = range(3, 20)
- $n2 = range(5, 30)
- $n3 = range(15, 50)
- $p1 = range(5, 15)
- $p2 = range(3, 10)
- $p3 = range(2, 8)


#answer: n1*p1 + n2*p2 + n3*p3

{name,Shiela} tana buƙatar gabatar da takardar bincike mai shafuka {n,15}. Ta riga ta kammala rubuta {frac,1/3} na {document,takardar binciken}. Yaushe shafuka ce ta rage ta rubuta?

#init:
- name = sample(names_female)
- document = sample(["essay", "report", "thesis", "dissertation", "assignment"])
- $n = range(10, 325)
- $frac = sample(fractions)

#conditions:
- is_int(n * frac)
- n * frac < n

#answer: n - int(n * frac)

Idan {name,Chester} ya ci gaba da cin kwai {n1,3} a kowace rana na tsawon rana {d1,30} sannan ya ƙara shi zuwa kwai {n2,5} a kowace rana na tsawon rana {d2,30}, nawa daga cikin gungun kwai (dozens) zai bukaci {name,Chester} na tsawon rana {d3,60}?

#init:
- name = sample(names)
- $n1 = range(2, 6)
- $n2 = range(4, 8)
- $d1 = range(20, 110, 2)
- $d2 = range(20, 110, 2)
- $d3 = range(50, 200, 5)

#conditions:
- d3 == d1 + d2
- n2 > n1
- divides(n1*d1 + n2*d2, 12)

#answer: (n1*d1 + n2*d2) // 12
